promptZh: 二號球場為什麼不開放？

options.text: Its lines have just been repainted.
options.whyZh: 工作人員今天重畫球場線，路障撤走前不開放。

options.text: Its net has not yet been delivered.
options.whyZh: 女方看見球網已架好，男方也說球網已架回去。

options.text: It has been reserved for a doubles competition.
options.whyZh: 雙打搭檔是女方同行的人，不是球場停用原因。

options.text: A practice wall is being built at its gate.
options.whyZh: 入口有路障，練習牆則是既有替代設施。

explanationZh: 工作人員今天重畫球場線，路障撤走前不開放。
evidence: We have Court Two booked at four. I can see the net is in place, but there’s a barrier at the gate. Is that booking still going ahead? / No. The crew repainted the lines today. The court stays closed until they remove the barrier, even though the net is back up. Court Three is free at five, or you can use the practice wall from four.
